title: Scholia vetera and Tzetzes on Aristophanes' Clouds / Схолии к «Облакам» Аристофана
author: Anonymous (Alexandrian sources, Symmachus); John Tzetzes
size: Clouds scholia (vetera + Tzetzes): est. ~60–80k words. Pilot: est. ~10k words.
edition: Holwerda 1977 and Koster 1960 (Groningen; in copyright). Dübner 1842 (Didot) is PD.
ru_evidence: Ancientrome.ru Aristophanes page has the comedies only. Torshilov's translation of the hypotheses of Aristophanes of Byzantium is not of the scholia.
en_evidence: Rutherford 1896–1905 covers the Ravenna scholia; English Wikipedia confirms the edition, while its English rendering comes from the title and was not re-verified. No modern English translation found.
other_translations: French: Chantry, scholia to Frogs and Plutus (2009–10; BMCR 2014.12.27).
value: Key evidence for Old Comedy staging, Athenian prosopography (komodoumenoi), lost comic fragments and the reception of Socrates. Tzetzes adds a Byzantine schoolroom voice.
ai_feasibility: Medium. Puns, proper names and Attic legal and cultic terms need specialist review.
pilot_unit: Scholia to Clouds 1–262 (Strepsiades, the phrontisterion); est. ~10k words.
